input.quote: their officers, directors, employees and agents (each, an "Indemnified Person")
input.rationale: Full-document searches for "solicit", "employ or engage", "hire"/"no-hire", "induce", "recruit", "employment", "personnel" and restrictive-covenant language return no responsive clause; the only reference to employees anywhere in the Transfer and Servicing Agreement is the indemnity definition of "Indemnified Person" in Section 6.3(i) (p0291), which imposes no hiring or solicitation restraint. The Issuer/Depositor (our party) are therefore under no non-solicitation, no-poach or no-hire covenant, which meets the preferred position ("No non-solicit on Customer"). No redline is warranted; we would only need the fallback carve-outs (mutuality, services personnel only, 12 months, general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach exclusions, no no-hire) if the Servicer/Marketing Agent later proposes adding such a covenant.
